name: cured leather
lore_descriptor: sun-cured brown leather, supple to the hand
first_pickup_chronicle: Cured leather. The honest material. Cattle and oak-tannin and a year hung in a barn. Doesn't surprise you, doesn't disappoint you.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 0.95, weight_mult 0.70, no effective_against (T2 leather). Standard leather sling material bridging rawhide to boiled.
